reason: A batch report I can actually open and match to the box number is the thing I always go looking for and rarely find. At $24.99 for one box I'd try it for my work trips, then decide after reading the report.
objection: There are no reviews yet, it's made in China, and 30 foil sachets a month is a lot of packaging waste for something I could pour out of a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out not to match the batch number on the box, or the lab was not a real lab I could look up, I would not buy.
